To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
pyrrolobenzimidazoles and pyrrolopyrroles are potent inhibitors of herpesviruses and human cytomegalo virus, and that they inhibit cdk1 but not cyclin-dependent kinaces.
pyrrolobenzodiazepines are selective antivirals that do not inhibit cdk1 or cyclin B.
pyrrolylpyrimidines are novel inhibitors of cdk1, but their antiviral potency is not related to their ability to inhibit cdk.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the discovery of selective antiviral agents.
the identification of novel antiviral agents and the elucidation of their mechanisms of action.
the discovery and development of antiviral agents that are selective inhibitors of HCMV and herpes simplex virus type-1 replication.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the antiviral activity of pyrrolocytosine derivatives is not due to the inhibition of cdk 1 and that these compounds constitute novel pharmacophore templates which can be used to develop selective and potent antiviral agents.
pyrrolos inhibit HSV-1 and HCMV replication by a mechanism unrelated to the inhibition of cdk activity.
the pyrrolopyrimidines are not selective antiviral agents but that they do have a novel mechanism of action.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
inhibition of cdfs is not the mechanism of antiviral activity of pyrrolylpyrimidines.
pyrrolylpyrimidines are selective inhibitors of cdk1 but not antivirals.
inhibition of cdc2 kinase is not the mechanism of the antiviral activity of pyrrolobenzodiazepines.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the inhibition of cyclin-dependent kinase by purines and pyrrolo [2,3-d]-pyrimidines does not correlate with antiviral efficacy.
inhibition of ckd1 and cyclin b is not responsible for the selective antiviral properties of pyrrolop[2,3-D]pyrimidins.
inhibition of cdc2 kinase by pyrrolopyrimidines is not responsible for the antiviral activity of this class of compounds.
